actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT *
FROM public.upsert_member_address(
  p_member_id => {{ this.params.member_id || appsmith.store.member_id }}::uuid,
  p_address_1 => {{ this.params.address_1 }},
  p_address_type => COALESCE(
    NULLIF(btrim({{ this.params.address_type }}), ''),
    'home'
  ),
  p_address_2 => {{ this.params.address_2 }},
  p_city => {{ this.params.city }},
  p_state => {{ this.params.state }},
  p_postal_code => {{ this.params.postal_code }},
  p_country => COALESCE(
    NULLIF(btrim({{ this.params.country }}), ''),
    'USA'
  ),
  p_is_primary => COALESCE({{ this.params.is_primary }}, false),
  p_source => 'manual',
  p_notes => {{ this.params.notes || null }}
);
